summary: Backend regression and persistence checks passed; dashboard walking flow and formulas passed, but date navigation crashes the React app.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking previous day causes an uncaught date-fns RangeError and replaces the dashboard with the runtime error overlay.

action_items: Change the date-fns format string `MMM D, YYYY` in App.js to Unicode-token-compatible `MMM d, yyyy`, then retest both previous and next day navigation and mobile rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js uses invalid date-fns v2+ token letters D and YYYY at the daily balance eyebrow; this is a user-visible runtime crash whenever a non-today date is rendered.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (walking formulas/save passed; date navigation and dependent mobile checks blocked)

seed_data_creation: Saved default settings weight 70 kg and activity 10,000 steps for 2099-01-02 during API regression; no meal seed remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop dashboard loaded. Walking 10,000 steps + 70 kg showed +350 kcal, 2,350 kcal burn, 2,350 kcal deficit, and 0.31 kg loss; save worked. Previous-day click crashed before mobile/date completion. Nutrition estimate API, meal CRUD, settings/activity persistence passed.
rca of the issue: App.js line 54 calls format(date, `MMM D, YYYY`). date-fns rejects legacy Moment-style tokens by default, throwing RangeError: Use `d` instead of `D` and `yyyy` instead of `YYYY`. The exception occurs after date navigation renders a non-today date, causing the uncaught runtime overlay.
